# Cape Cod / Martha's Vineyard / Waquoit Bay — 1:1 Minecraft

True **1 block = 1 meter** Minecraft Java (1.20.4) worlds built from
**USGS 3DEP 1‑meter** elevation + Esri World Imagery, with real **sea level**:
oceans, bays, estuaries and kettle ponds are filled with water; land rises above.

Each zip is one standalone, openable world (unzip into your `saves/` folder).
All tiles share one coordinate system (1 block = 1 m east/north), so they are
geo-referenced consistently. Each tile is ~6 km × 6 km (≈36 km²).

## Covering the rest of the Cape

The full peninsula is ~150 more land tiles (~9 h build, ~12 GB) — generated by
the **resumable** `run_areas.py` sweep (`RUN_GRID=1`), which builds every
land‑bearing 6 km tile and pushes one zip per tile, skipping any already
delivered. Run it again to keep extending coverage; finished tiles are never
rebuilt.
